Gate B · keyframes complete · zero credits spent

24 generative shots + 3 deterministic. Every frame here is a locked keyframe still, the start image for its Seedance shot. Text (राम on the boulders, the stripe reveal, captions, the ZebPay card) is finished as clean Mode-B overlays, never trusted to the model. The two-frame S4-c pair is the small-settle stage for the hardest shot.

Next: your approval, then the spend gate (final prompts + verified credit cost), then a single S1-a pilot before the full batch animates. Alternates on hand: S1-d close-up, S7-a v2 (grittier), and montage variants (overcast, misty dawn) for Scene 5.
